description: Defines the AllOf validation rule class within the OrangeHRM Core API, implementing a composite validation rule by extending AbstractComposite and returning the specific validation class from Respect\Validation.

classes.name: AllOf
classes.description: A validation rule class that combines multiple rules using 'all of' logic, extending AbstractComposite and providing the specific rule class from the Respect Validation library.

methods.name: getRuleClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the validation rule from the Respect\Validation library that this composite rule is wrapping; in this case, 'Rules\AllOf'.
